item.description:

The lack of progress to finish these works means cars and motorcycles are constantly driving on the pavement seen in the photo which is clearly illegal due to lack of clear signposting and blocking this bit off to motorists creating a very unsafe environment for residents and pedestrians for several months.

item.title: Van left on chesworth close, 12th August
item.description:

Company that driver worked for has been contacted several times, company confirmed van broken down and promised to respond each time but no communication received and no attempt at removal or attending the van since it was left. Van window has been left open, bottle of urine left on the curb.
